method: Synthetic timeline containing independent fades on one track. Hot query medians from 9 batches of 2000 operations after 1000 warmup calls; query positions vary deterministically. Same checksum before/after. Timings are wall-clock on a shared loaded host, not application FPS. Recorded hot values came from separate before/after runs before cold-build timing was added. The current harness keeps the same hot-query batches and optionally runs both implementations in one process; its output is new evidence, not a replacement for these historical measurements.
build_method: Baseline module restored from baseline_commit in a temporary sibling module. Alternating baseline/current order in the same process. 10 warmups then median of 30 independent rebuilds; fresh transition record copied before each timer. Uses the upper-middle sorted sample (index 15), matching the shipped optional-baseline harness. Without a baseline argument the harness measures current builds only, using the same 10 warmups and 30 samples.
cost: Additional 8 bytes per transition for prefix maximum ends. Build has additional linear work and weak-map metadata; overlap-heavy queries can still scan many candidates. The 10000-item cold-build increase is visible and amortized over subsequent pointer/window queries.
reproduce_notes: Run from repository root. The temporary baseline module stays next to the current module so its relative imports resolve. The paired command alternates cold-build ordering and reports baseline/current hot-query medians plus independent checksums; it throws if those checksums differ. Historical cold timings were collected in a dedicated build-only run using the same alternating method; hot-query work between sizes in the combined harness may affect JIT/GC state.
